record.question: The percentage compensation in gradient for ruling gradient of 4% and horizontal curve of radius 760 m is
record.explanation: Curve gradient compensation for roads is taken as 75/R percent with R in metres, giving 75/760 ≈ 0.099%, which rounds to 0.1%. The printed options match the PDF page 1 item 8, and this relies on the standard road-compensation formula rather than a source-stated value.
